news.summary: Microsoft Research has developed a machine learning model that can forecast space‑weather events, providing 30‑60 minute warnings before a storm could damage power grids and disrupt GPS and satellite operations.

news.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
news.summary_raw:
Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.
The post Introducing Q
news.summary: Microsoft Research has unveiled Quine, an AI research system that builds a multimodal world model of biology to connect insights across scales and modalities. It aims to accelerate hypothesis generation and experimental design for biologists.
news.enterprise_use: No immediate action is required for Ahmed's IT stack; the announcement is purely research-focused and does not impact Google Workspace, JumpCloud, Freshservice, or related IT tools.
